what_changed: Flippable snapshot = the full 2026-06-05_def14a fileset (symlink-inherited; def14a itself inherits 2026-05-27) PLUS a new calendar-month CRSP returns panel and a re-emitted annual returns file. crsp_monthly_returns.csv: one row per (gvkey,month) -- gvkey, permno, date(month-end), year, month, ret, retx, prc, shrout, me=|prc|*shrout ($000s); built from crsp.msf (legacy SIZ), gvkey<->permno via crsp.ccmxpf_lnkhist (LU/LC, P/C) with link-window filter, dedupe to one permno per (gvkey,month) preferring linkprim='P'. crsp_annual_returns.csv REPLACES the broken inherited symlink (the 2026-04-28 build wrote the Series name 'ret' into the permno column); re-emitted with the real permno -- returns are byte-identical, only permno changed. Calendar months only -- no fiscal mapping (downstream builder does calendar->fiscal). `current` NOT flipped.
inheritance: All files except crsp_monthly_returns.csv and crsp_annual_returns.csv are symlink-inherited unchanged from 2026-06-05_def14a (which symlink-inherits 2026-05-27). See that release's MANIFEST for their build provenance, key_metrics, age_method, and the 2026-06-06 augmentation (def14a_director_attributes, gender/primary_company).
crsp_source_table: crsp.msf (legacy SIZ monthly file); links from crsp.ccmxpf_lnkhist; gvkey universe from data/extracted/combined/all_people.csv; pull 2010-2025 (one leading year => 2009 start); msf data ends 2024-12 on this WRDS instance.

crsp_annual_returns.csv.note: Re-emitted with permno bug fixed (was 'ret' in the 2026-04-28 build); returns byte-identical, only permno changed. Replaces the broken inherited symlink.

crsp_monthly_returns.csv.note: NEW in this release. Calendar-month panel + market-equity for Chat 3's sub-annual / size-weighting specs.
